events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Michael Philip Jagger, known as the lead singer of The Rolling Stones, was born on July 26, 1943.

angles.name: Mick Jagger's Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the legendary frontman of The Rolling Stones, Mick Jagger. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed the Radio Star' being the very first music video aired.

angles.name: MTV Launch Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the day music changed forever? 45 years ago, MTV burst onto our screens, kicking off with The Buggles. What was the first music video that truly blew your mind?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe 32 years on
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, featuring classic tracks like 'Live Forever' and 'Supersonic'.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your top track from that legendary debut?

events.title: Woodstock Festival 57 years ago
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music and Art Fair, a pivotal event in music history, took place from August 15 to 18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: Imagine half a million people, three days of peace and music. 57 years ago, Woodstock made history. If you could have been there, who would you have wanted to see?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977, at his Graceland estate in Memphis, Tennessee.

angles.name: Elvis Presley Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll. What's your all-time favourite Elvis song?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, widely regarded as one of the greatest guitarists of all time, passed away on September 18, 1970, in London.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled guitar genius, Jimi Hendrix. His influence is still felt across music decades later. What's your go-to Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road 57 years on
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That iconic zebra crossing, those timeless tracks. Which song is a must-listen for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Christine Ellen Hynde, known as the lead vocalist, guitarist, and primary songwriter of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon and the voice of The Pretenders. What's your favourite track from her?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, known as the lead singer of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation and still rocking. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' 55 years on
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in October 1971, becoming his best-selling solo single.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The original iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket.'

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the revolution? 25 years ago, the first iPod dropped, changing how we carry our music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', premiering in London in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab a martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Winston Ono Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and a prolific solo artist, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire. What's the Lennon song that moves you most?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Marwood Cleese, the acclaimed English actor, comedian, and screenwriter, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British icon. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' 58 years on
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, in the UK.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A double LP packed with innovation and diverse sounds. Which track stands out for you?
